text:
morgan: Quick final sweep — cut is in ~2h. Please add a compact release snippet for any PR you touched to KEEP_A_CHANGELOG and ensure an owner is tagged. Also tag the branch for the bump (release/v0.12.x).

morgan: Use this tiny template, one line per PR, start with component tag and keep it factual. Example below — paste under the PR description or add to the changelog file.

```
[component] Short, present-tense summary. (PR #1234)
```

riley: on it. i'll add entries for my UI fixes (PR #4289) and the flag rename.

sam: quick q — do we want micro-summaries for infra ops too, or lump under [infra]?

morgan: keep infra ops as [infra], but if it's customer-facing detail, split into separate line. aim for ~10-15 words.

anya: I'll own backend entries. adding two lines now for telemetry and cache eviction (PRs #4290 #4291).

riley: added PR #4289 snippet to the changelog and tagged @anya as reviewer.

sam: added infra entry for the autoscaler tweak (PR #4288). left the branch tag in the PR title as `release/v0.12.4`.

release-captain: Heads-up — bump candidate is v0.12.4. Can we confirm all release notes are in by the cutoff (15m)?

morgan: yes, v0.12.4. If you haven't added a line, please do it now. After cutoff we freeze CHANGELOG and open the bump PR.

deploy-bot: changelog-lint scheduled: run will execute at +10m and report errors inline.

sam: saw lint error on formatting (missing component bracket), fixed.

riley: tiny nit — used present tense for one line, changed to present-tense to match style.

anya: all done from backend side. pinged @morgan for confirmation.

morgan: checking briefly... looks good. thanks all. I'll open the bump PR once deploy-bot gives green.

release-captain: last call — if anything critical is missing, flag now. otherwise we proceed with release/v0.12.4 tag and bump PR. :shipit:

riley: all set from my side :+1:

sam: good here too.

morgan: thanks team — appreciate the quick turn.

deploy-bot: changelog-lint: 0 errors, 2 warnings (style).

morgan: will address warnings in the bump PR description. merging in ~5m. :eyes:
